qi-shape.label: Qi-Shape
qi-shape.description: A qi-shape action is a special action that requires that you have at least 1 Focus Point remaining in your Focus Pool. You must spend 1 Focus Point when you use the Energize entry for a qi-shape action, and doing so modifies the action’s properties as described in its entry. You cannot use more than one qi-shape action per turn. When you gain a new qi-shape action, you increase your Focus Pool by 1 point.
